panel.name: panel_lens_gaze

combo_box.name: gaze_edit_actor
combo_box.tool_tip: Which actor the controls below edit. All broadcasts every edit to every populated actor; You / A-D edit only that one actor. Choosing an actor here never toggles its camera look-at.

text.name: gaze_status
text.tool_tip: Shows the edited actor's gaze state; commits apply to the edited actor (or every populated actor in All)

check_box.label: Look at camera (global master)
check_box.name: look_at_camera_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Master gate for rendering flagged real cast avatars looking at this viewer's camera. Local visual override only: no simulator, animation signal, or network state is changed

check_box.label: You
check_box.name: gaze_slot_you
check_box.tool_tip: Toggle camera look-at for your avatar

check_box.label: A
check_box.name: gaze_slot_a
check_box.tool_tip: Toggle camera look-at for Subject A

check_box.label: B
check_box.name: gaze_slot_b
check_box.tool_tip: Toggle camera look-at for Subject B

check_box.label: C
check_box.name: gaze_slot_c
check_box.tool_tip: Toggle camera look-at for Subject C

check_box.label: D
check_box.name: gaze_slot_d
check_box.tool_tip: Toggle camera look-at for Subject D

check_box.label: Enabled for selection
check_box.name: gaze_enable_check
check_box.tool_tip: Procedural look-at for selected actor. Off is a no-op and the actor's own motion plays.

combo_box.name: gaze_range_preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a rotation-range preset to the edited actor(s): sets Limits source + the whole per-joint limit profile below, plus Exaggerate. Fields stay editable afterward (shown as Custom).

combo_box.name: gaze_target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What the active You/A-D actor looks at

combo_box.name: gaze_eye_target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Relaxed: eyes stay neutral in the socket and only drift/microsaccade (head still tracks its own target). Near-lens (just off camera): eyes aim at the camera like the head but sit a few living degrees off the lens -- almost contact, but alive. Follow head: eyes track the head target. Camera/Cast member/Fixed point/Object: independent eye target.

button.name: reset_gaze_eye_target
button.tool_tip: Reset eye target to Follow head

combo_box.name: gaze_priority_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How completely gaze owns its joints when it is allowed to write. Does not consult SL animation priority.

combo_box.name: gaze_ik_lean_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: IK Lean: apply a spine-lean preset (curve + threshold/max/softness + chest share) to the edited actor(s). Enabled only while Movement Style is Planted spine (IK).

combo_box.name: gaze_anim_priority_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Gaze yields on each joint to animations above this priority. Equal priority favors gaze. Legacy final ignores animation priority.

button.name: reset_gaze_anim_priority
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

combo_box.name: gaze_composition_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What endpoint gaze writes when a joint is allowed: Replace matches current behavior; Additive overlay computes the smallest correction onto the animation pose; Blend nlerps the two endpoints using Animation retention below.

button.name: reset_gaze_composition
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

slider.label: Animation retention
slider.name: gaze_composition_mix_slider
slider.tool_tip: Blend composition mix: 0 = Replace endpoint, 1 = Additive endpoint. Shown/used only while Pose composition above is Blend.

button.name: reset_gaze_composition_mix
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

combo_box.name: gaze_target_detail_scope
combo_box.tool_tip: Choose whether the shared cast, point, and object controls edit the head target or optional eye target

combo_box.name: gaze_cast_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Cast member for the Head/Eyes target selected at left

button.label: Set point from camera
button.name: btn_gaze_setpoint
button.tool_tip: Capture the current camera position as the fixed point the active You/A-D actor looks at

button.label: Pick selected object
button.name: btn_gaze_pick_object
button.tool_tip: Set the in-world selected object / linkset as the gaze target

combo_box.name: gaze_performance_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a performance preset to the active You/A-D subject

button.name: reset_gaze_performance
button.tool_tip: Clear preset overrides to neutral defaults

slider.label: Transition (s)
slider.name: gaze_transition_slider
slider.tool_tip: Blend duration when a performance preset is applied: continuous params ease from the current feel to the preset over this time. 0 = instant snap (legacy).

combo_box.name: gaze_easing_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Curve shape for the preset transition blend

check_box.label: Auto-cycle presets
check_box.name: gaze_random_check
check_box.tool_tip: Automatically retarget each edited actor to a random performance preset on its own jittered interval, blended with the Transition/Easing above

slider.label: Interval (s)
slider.name: gaze_random_interval_slider
slider.tool_tip: Average seconds between random preset changes; each actor jitters +/-25% off this so they never switch in lockstep

slider.label: Dominance
slider.name: gaze_persona_dom_slider
slider.tool_tip: Persona dominance: longer contact, squarer head, fewer blinks

slider.label: Affection
slider.name: gaze_persona_aff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Persona affection: softer acquisition, warm eyeline, gentle lid narrow

slider.label: Anxiety
slider.name: gaze_persona_anx_slider
slider.tool_tip: Persona anxiety: shorter contact, downward aversion, more micro-life

slider.label: Head/eyes
slider.name: gaze_blend_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 = eyes only; 1 = full head, neck and torso turn

slider.label: Torso
slider.name: gaze_torso_slider
slider.tool_tip: How much of the accepted gaze aim the torso shares

slider.label: Base intensity
slider.name: gaze_intensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Static per-actor gaze strength. Multiplied by the keyframed Influence @ playhead below -- this is not a timeline envelope by itself.

slider.label: Influence @ playhead
slider.name: gaze_influence_slider
slider.tool_tip: Evaluated keyframed influence at the current presentation-time playhead: a final write-weight multiplier, not a pose. Empty track = always 1. Drag to a new value, then Set/Update key to author a key at the current playhead. Disabled in All scope.

button.label: Set/Update key
button.name: btn_gaze_influence_set
button.tool_tip: Author or replace an influence key at the current playhead using the slider value above

button.label: Delete key
button.name: btn_gaze_influence_delete
button.tool_tip: Remove the influence key at the current playhead, if one exists

slider.label: Smoothing
slider.name: gaze_smoothing_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 = snappy; 1 = very smooth

slider.label: Eyeline yaw
slider.name: gaze_eyeline_yaw_slider
slider.tool_tip: Actor-local left/right off-camera eyeline in degrees

slider.label: Eyeline pitch
slider.name: gaze_eyeline_pitch_slider
slider.tool_tip: Actor-local up/down off-camera eyeline in degrees

slider.label: Stillness
slider.name: gaze_stillness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Cinematic stillness: at 1 the head, neck and torso barely move (frozen body) while the eyes and micro-life stay fully alive. 0 = default.

slider.label: Restraint
slider.name: gaze_restraint_slider
slider.tool_tip: Cinematic restraint: globally scales down micro-life, saccades, blink rate and head-turn magnitude for a subtler performance (1 = very restrained, not frozen). 0 = default.

slider.label: Micro-life
slider.name: gaze_microlife_slider
slider.tool_tip: Procedural micro-life intensity (saccades, blinks, head drift)

check_box.label: Enabled
check_box.name: gaze_blinks_check
check_box.tool_tip: Enable deterministic periodic eyelid blinks during locked gaze

slider.label: Variation
slider.name: gaze_variation_slider
slider.tool_tip: Per-subject natural variation in intensity, smoothing, and cadence

slider.label: Glance breaks
slider.name: gaze_break_freq_slider
slider.tool_tip: Frequency of natural glances away from target

spinner.label: Release (s)
spinner.name: gaze_ease_release_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Time to release target lock back to animation

spinner.label: Dead zone (deg)
spinner.name: gaze_deadzone_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Body-chain dead zone; eyes continue micro-tracking inside it

check_box.label: Break off past
check_box.name: gaze_breakoff_check
check_box.tool_tip: Ease gaze out when the target passes the angle at right

spinner.name: gaze_breakoff_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Body-relative yaw where Break off disengages gaze

slider.label: Camera roll
slider.name: gaze_camera_roll_slider
slider.tool_tip: Cock the head with the live CAMERA target's dutch angle; the neck follows by a smaller share

slider.label: Exaggerate
slider.name: gaze_exaggerate_slider
slider.tool_tip: Scale eye, head, and neck limits from human (1) to extreme (3)

slider.label: Chest share
slider.name: gaze_chest_share_slider
slider.tool_tip: Share of the conserved spine (torso+chest) bucket given to the chest joint instead of the torso. Does not add reach. Enabled only for Ownership scope Planted spine (IK).

button.name: reset_gaze_chest_share
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

combo_box.name: gaze_limit_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Inherit follows the global custom-limits switch below (DirectorGazeCustomLimitsEnabled). Legacy constants forces the original hardcoded cones for this actor. Custom uses this actor's profile in the grid below.

text.name: gaze_limit_grid_lbl
text.tool_tip: This actor's custom cone limits. Only consulted while Limits source above is Custom for this actor.

button.name: reset_gaze_limit_profile
button.tool_tip: Reset this actor's custom limit profile to defaults

spinner.name: gaze_limit_eyeapply_yaw_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Final applied eye socket yaw cap

spinner.name: gaze_limit_eyeapply_pitch_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Final applied eye socket pitch-down cap

spinner.name: gaze_limit_eyeapply_pitchup_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Final applied eye socket pitch-up cap

spinner.name: gaze_limit_eye_radial_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Final applied eye socket radial cone cap

combo_box.name: gaze_lean_curve_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Legacy fill uses the original hard capacity order (default, bit-identical). Angle ease drives spine recruitment from aim angle via the Threshold/Softness/Max below. Angle ease is applied only when Ownership scope is Planted spine.

button.name: reset_gaze_lean_curve
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

spinner.label: Lean threshold (deg)
spinner.name: gaze_lean_threshold_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Aim magnitude where the spine starts to ease in. Enabled only for Lean Angle ease and Ownership scope Planted spine.

button.name: reset_gaze_lean_threshold
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

spinner.label: Lean softness (deg)
spinner.name: gaze_lean_softness_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Width of the smootherstep ease band above the threshold. 0 = hard step. Enabled only for Lean Angle ease and Ownership scope Planted spine.

button.name: reset_gaze_lean_softness
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

spinner.label: Lean max (deg)
spinner.name: gaze_lean_max_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Combined angular magnitude cap on the spine's share of the aim. Enabled only for Lean Angle ease and Ownership scope Planted spine.

button.name: reset_gaze_lean_max
button.tool_tip: Reset to inherit the global default

spinner.label: Soft recruit (deg)
spinner.name: gaze_soft_recruit_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Motor-only: smooths joint capacity handoffs at each anatomical knee (0 = legacy hard knee). This is NOT the Lean angle/threshold curve above -- it shapes remaining face-chain capacity transfer, the Lean curve shapes the spine's share of the aim.

panel.text: Strength/Head-eyes/Torso/Smoothing/Ease here are shared global fallbacks for camera-facing cast; Mode and every row above are per actor (or broadcast in All).

combo_box.name: look_at_camera_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Gaze keeps the current head/eye behavior. Turn body eases the rendered avatar root toward the camera and locally layers a turn animation

spinner.label: Strength
spinner.name: look_at_camera_strength
spinner.tool_tip: Blend weight for the local head and eye camera gaze

slider.label: Head/eyes
slider.name: look_at_camera_head_eye
slider.tool_tip: 0 uses eyes only; 1 gives the head and neck their full share

check_box.label: Enabled
check_box.name: look_at_camera_torso
check_box.tool_tip: Master gate for the base torso amount; off keeps the effect to head, neck, and eyes

slider.label: Torso amount
slider.name: look_at_camera_torso_amount
slider.tool_tip: Base torso share when Torso contribution is enabled

slider.label: Smoothing
slider.name: look_at_camera_smoothing
slider.tool_tip: Base camera-gaze smoothing: 0 is snappy; 1 is very smooth

slider.label: Ease master
slider.name: look_at_camera_ease_time
slider.tool_tip: Master scale for both acquire and release; 0.15 uses the authored durations

panel.text: Editing (top) chooses the actor these rows edit: All broadcasts to every populated actor; You / A-D edit one.

button.label: Gaze Cues...
button.name: btn_gaze_cues
button.tool_tip: Edit presentation-time gaze cues for the active You/A-D subject
